title: Zoning text change for 21-31 46th Avenue, Long Island City
summary: This resolution approves with modifications a zoning text amendment creating a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 21-31 46th Avenue in Long Island City, Queens. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would allow an 11-story mixed-use building with about 84 apartments, including 21 income-restricted units. The Council held a public hearing on September 9, 2026 before approving the measure.
